variables.name: Vacuum Wavelength
variables.description: Wavelength of light wave in a vacuum before entering a medium

variables.name: Wave Frequency
variables.description: Number of wave oscillations per second; remains constant across media.

variables.name: Phase Velocity
variables.description: Ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to its speed in a medium.

variables.name: Refractive Index
variables.description: Ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to its speed in a medium.

variables.name: Wave Number
variables.description: Spatial frequency of a wave representing radians per unit length (2𝜋/𝜆).

variables.name: Alpha
variables.description: Small angle in paraxial approximation / Prism apex geometry

variables.name: Beta
variables.description: Total diffraction phase difference across single slit width

variables.name: Gamma
variables.description: Ray angle in spherical surface refraction derivations

variables.name: Phi
variables.description: Phase difference in wave interference / Polarization angle

variables.name: Theta
variables.description: Wavelength of light wave in a vacuum before entering a medium
